Fix direction: lift that branch into a shared pure function the way QueuesParallelAuditFix was lifted, and let NextAction carry the decision THROUGH the scheduling to the session it produces (LaunchStep.ScheduleGateOrAudit + Kind=Audit + the composed prompt), or at minimum make the headline state that the launch schedules AND then spawns the audit. src/Conductor/Commands/PreflightCommand.Compose.cs:164-167 emits the headline with no detail line, so nothing discloses it.

verifier_summary: REFUTED (round 7). The four v6/ rigs the round-6 fix was built against all re-verify green at HEAD 7684efc (rig-pa drill 7673 = launch 7673; rig-wf 6976 vs 6975; rig-wf2 7104 vs 7105; rig-pa-med 10094 vs 10093 with the cmd.exe-shim warn firing — the 1-char gaps are the disclosed ToolContract pid width, measured with File.ReadAllText; note PS 5.1's Get-Content -Raw mis-decodes UTF-8 and inflates these counts by ~50, which is what the rigs print). Build clean, the checkpoint's pinned suites are green (188 passed: KS3_4Preflight, K7_2DocsVerbCoverage, B11_2, DoctorCommandTests, JourneyCommandTests, SF7_1DocsMatchReality, UpdateCheck, Architecture), hygiene is clean (worktree clean, all 37 changed paths in-repo, no plan/golden/price-table edits, conventional commits with trailers, main repo C:/Code/conductor unmodified). But the claim "the class is now closed by construction" is false: the shared decision still ENDS BEFORE the session begins on all three of the compose leg's "no session composes" branches, because RunLoop executes those branches and then RE-DECIDES inside the same `conductor run` — the exact round-6 defect at branches round 6 never drove through a real dispatch. Three live reproductions, drill vs real launch on identical fixtures: (1) perPhase + audit.enabled + a done-but-unconfirmed stage — drill "schedules the audit / full-battery phase gate — no session composes" + READY/exit 0, launch spawns `session #2 Audit S1`, 7114-char prompt; this one involves NO subprocess at all (GateOrchestrator.ScheduleGateOrAudit branches purely on plan.Audit.Enabled/EnableParallel, state.AuditedStages and the next-unconfirmed-stage test), so it sits squarely inside NextAction's own "pure function of the saved state" contract; (2) tracker all DONE + a red required gate — drill "confirms completion rather than spawning a session" + READY, launch runs the battery, queues a fix and spawns `session #2 Fix S1`, 7800 chars; (3) a queued pendingPhaseGate + a red gate — drill "runs the queued full-battery phase gate — no session composes" + READY, launch spawns `session #2 Fix S1`, 7757 chars. In all three the verdict line reads "READY — nothing has spent anything. Launch with conductor run", and the launch's next act is a real agent session; none of the three is disclosed in the leg's output or in NextAction's stated exclusion list. The suite cannot catch any of them because the only ground truth for those branches is `run --dry-run`, which returns at the branch (RunLoop.cs:189, :261) — the round-6 store-backed `LiveSessionAsync` harness is never pointed at them. Rigs: scratchpad/v7/rig-phase-audit.ps1, rig-complete-red2.ps1, rig-queued-gate-red.ps1.
